_what: Facts that override the run_config.json texts on EOS (the operator's word, recorded after the runs were taken).

runs_112_on_hv.wrong_text: lab_hv_state_declared: 'The detector-side HV connectors were MOVED from 4,5,6 to 2,3,4 on all three chambers'
runs_112_on_hv.fact: HV connectors NOT moved. Only the voltages changed on 2026-10-26: P2_IN (det3) mesh 420 / drift 720 V; P2_MID (det2) and P2_OUT (det1) mesh 430 / drift 730 V. Before (runs 57-111): mesh 410 / drift 710 V presumed.

runs_112_on_readout.fact: Read-out connectors moved from c4-c6 to c3-c5 (3 of the 10 connectors of each chamber), same hybrids and VMMs: H1/H4/H7 on c3, H2/H5/H8 on c4, H3/H6/H9 on c5. The same VMM channels read different pads. The cabling_note and the connector table of run_config.json (c3/c4/c5) are correct.

runs_1_111_on_readout.fact: The DATA place hybrids H1-H3 / H4-H6 / H7-H9 on connectors c5-c7 (Gerber numbering of the pad map), not c4-c6 as the cabling_note says: 511 +- 10 straight tracks/h above the chip-preserving chance level at --conn-shift 1, about 10/h at every other shift (runs 76-91 pooled). From run_112 the data say c3-c5 (--conn-shift -1), i.e. a move of two connectors in that numbering.
